artifact.description: Relative path to the primary .onnx file inside a Hugging Face snapshot.

max_batch_size.description: Ceiling used for dynamic batch models.

execution_providers.description: Preferred ONNX Runtime execution providers in priority order.

inter_op_num_threads.description: Inter-op thread count passed to ONNX Runtime.

intra_op_num_threads.description: Intra-op thread count passed to ONNX Runtime.

generation.description: Which kniv NLP generation the model repo holds. Inferred from the repo (onnx/onnx_meta.json means v7) when omitted.

variant.description: kniv v7 precision fallback chain, e.g. "" (fp32), "fp16", or "int8,fp16": for each graph the first suffix that exists is used, else the fp32 file.

calibration_path.description: Relative path to a kniv v7 calibration.json inside the repo. Default: calibration.json.

label_bank_path.description: Relative path to a kniv v7 label_bank.json inside the repo, which marks the relations whose thresholds were tuned. Default: label_bank.json.
